name: Sorcerer
description: Sorcerers carry a magical birthright conferred upon them by an exotic bloodline, some otherworldly influence, or exposure to unknown cosmic forces.

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: Your arcane magic depends on your ability to project your will into the world. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your sorcerer spells.

1.name: Sorcerous Origin
1.description: Choose a sorcerous origin, which describes the source of your innate magical power.
